description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonService component in a Spring Boot application. It tests CRUD operations on the Person entity by mocking dependencies like PersonRepository, without involving the actual data layer or Spring context. The focus is on verifying the business logic layer in isolation.

classes.name: PersonServiceUnitTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class designed to verify the functionality of PersonService methods, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting a Person entity using mocks.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock behavior for the PersonRepository and JacksonTester before each test execution.

methods.name: testCRUD
methods.description: Performs a sequence of CRUD operation tests on PersonService, verifying JSON serialization, method calls, and mock interactions.
